about: A self-hosted budget tracker and personal finance app.

prs.title: CSV imports keep large amounts with thousands separators
prs.broken: Importing a CSV with amounts like 3,250,000 saved them as 3.25, with no warning, so transactions and balances were wrong.
prs.changed: Repeated thousands separators, including Indian style 1,00,000, are now read as grouping, and odd ones are rejected.
prs.matters: Imported bank data gives the right amounts and balances.

prs.title: OFX imports accept French bank amount formats
prs.broken: Bank statements with a plus sign or a decimal comma in amounts, common in French bank exports, were rejected and nothing was imported.
prs.changed: Both forms are now read, while ambiguous amounts are still rejected.
prs.matters: Users of those banks can import their statements.
